roles.title: Senior/ Principal Product Manager, Trading(Crypto.com App)

bullets: Own the Trading roadmap. You set milestones, surface dependencies, and keep strategic priorities honest. You make the prioritization call when everything can't ship at once.
Define and ship trading experiences. You write the specs, run user studies, iterate on feedback, partner with QA on test plans, and clear the backlog. Nothing in your charter goes…
Stay close to how traders actually behave. You interview and observe customers. You ask "Show me how you currently trade and manage risk," not "Would you use this feature?" You…
Cut the hard tradeoffs. You weigh speed vs. depth, retail clarity vs. power-user needs, and compliance constraints vs. product ambition- and you own the decision.
Drive market and competitive clarity. You run the research that informs what we build next. Your work shows up in the roadmap, not a slide deck that dies in a folder.

Extend the platform across products. You take onboarding capabilities built for the Main App and adapt them for other platforms and future product surfaces without creating…
Own a meaningful trading slice. You pick up trading-product work alongside Trading team and connect onboarding to first trade and continued participation. You do not need to be…

roles.title: OG.com - Senior Product Manager - Fiat Onboarding

Own the funding product. You decide funding methods, payouts, limits, retries, and partner UX, spanning ACH, cards, instant funding, and whatever else clears in the U.S.…
Treat the money-in funnel as a growth surface. You instrument the drop-off, go after the leaks, and sequence your work against conversion. On the handoff from funded to first…
Hold the design bar on trust and money UX. Clarity, hierarchy, and clean error states aren’t negotiable. When someone’s entering a debit card or waiting on an ACH, “good enough”…
Wireframe and partner on design. You build your own wires and drive the design conversation, catching the clunky funding and KYC moments before users hit them.

Ship the product fans actually use. You prioritize market discovery, order entry, positions, parlays / multi-leg, live, and the workflows that keep sports and prediction users…
Bridge native prediction (or perps) into regulated event contracts. You take patterns fans already know -sportsbooks, prediction apps, or retail advanced trading -and make them…
Hold the design bar. You champion usability and aesthetics as non-negotiable. You live in design reviews and give specific, actionable UX feedback -spacing, interaction patterns…
Wireframe and partner in Figma. You create your own wires and drive design conversations. You catch pixel misalignments and clunky trade flows before users do.
